title: The next phase of OpenAI’s Education for Countries
summary: OpenAI advances Education for Countries, expanding AI adoption in schools with new partnerships, teacher training, and tools to improve global learning outcomes.
body: OpenAI advances Education for Countries, expanding AI adoption in schools with new partnerships, teacher training, and tools to improve global learning outcomes.
summaryZh: OpenAI宣布推进“各国教育计划”（Education for Countries）的下一阶段，通过引入新的战略合作伙伴关系、定制化的教师培训以及创新学习工具，进一步在全球范围内推动人工智能在学校教育中的普及与应用。
